outcome: Prevalence of pregnant women ≥ 35 years old
Incidence of maternal and perinatal morbidity and mortality
cohort: Women ≥ 20 years-old who gave birth over one year (n = 1378)
finding: Advanced maternal age was associated with a higher likelihood of gestational diabetes, hypothyroidism, and longer hospital admissions, but not a higher rate of C-sections.
mod_finding: Advanced maternal age was associated with a lower probability of eutocic delivery.
